summary.name: DNS Optimizer
summary.one_liner: DNS Optimizer is a DNS changer and benchmarking app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac that switches between DNS servers and measures their latency.
use_cases: Switching DNS servers on a Mac, iPhone or iPad
Finding the fastest DNS server for your network
Setting up encrypted DNS (DoH or DoT)
Blocking ads or malware at the DNS level
Reducing lag and ping in online games
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you change DNS settings for Wi-Fi and cellular networks on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with a single tap. It includes pre-configured DNS servers such as Cloudflare DNS, Google Public DNS, and Quad9. You can add custom DNS servers, including those using DNS over HTTPS (DoH) or DNS over TLS (DoT). A built-in benchmark runs DNS latency tests to compare servers and identify the fastest one for your network. The page also presents DNS servers designed for ad blocking, malware protection, or parental controls as options.
notable: Benchmarks DNS latency and compares servers
Supports custom encrypted DNS via DoH and DoT
Per-network DNS settings for Wi-Fi and cellular
Listed as freeware in the awesome-mac list
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing describes it as freeware, and it is distributed via the App Store
